about_the_game:
You're trapped in a disturbing night loop, forced to explore eerie environments and detect unnatural changes that reveal the presence of malevolent forces. At the end of each scenario, you must make a critical decision: enter the green door if you believe the place is safe, or the red door if you suspect paranormal activity. Your judgment is everything.

The demo includes two playable environments—a house and a church—each filled with unsettling details and potential anomalies.

> ⚠️ The demo does not include the main story, intentionally left out to avoid spoilers for players who haven't experienced the first chapter.

---

Key Features:

First-person psychological horror

Paranormal anomalies to detect

Green or red door mechanic based on your observations

Two creepy demo locations: house and church

Tense, immersive atmosphere with sound design and jumpscares

Keyboard and mouse only (no controller support)

Short but impactful gameplay (~10–15 minutes)

Contains disturbing imagery and scenes not suitable for all players

---

The full version will feature more environments, a deeper narrative, and an even darker dive into fear and madness.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 a 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 o AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti o equivalente
  • Storage: 4000 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 a 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4570 o AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti o superiore
  • Storage: 4000 MB available space

short_description: After a prank gone horribly wrong, you're ensnared in a nightmarish loop crafted by your own mother. As you delve into her twisted past, the boundaries between reality and madness blur. Unravel the sinister secrets and confront the malevolent forces that bind you.
